text:
alex: customer (acme-corp) reports LLM tool invocation failing with 400 schema error. payload attached.

eli: can you paste the exact request and error?

alex: sure, payload:
```
POST /v1/func/invoke
{
  "session": "s-123",
  "billing_profile": { "id": null },
  "order_id": 12345,
  "items": [ {"sku":"X1","qty":1} ]
}
```
error:
```
{
 "error": "validation_failed",
 "details": "billing_profile.id: required",
 "validator": "additionalProperties=false, type mismatch"
}
```

maria: quick triage — looks like two problems: billing_profile.id missing (required) and order_id type is number but schema expects string. Also there is an extra top-level `session` field the schema doesn't allow for this endpoint.

sam: @maria good catch. Do we know SDK version? older SDKs used numeric order ids.

alex: customer using redwood-js v0.9.1. repro steps: send same request via curl, fails immediate 400.

maria: can you repro locally with the server logs? share request id if present.

alex: request-id: r-2026031512. logs:
```
WARN schema: payload additional properties: session
ERROR schema: missing required 'billing_profile.id'
ERROR schema: type mismatch 'order_id' expected string got integer
```

maria: ok will push a compatibility shim to coerce order_id to string and return clearer error when billing_profile.id missing. But we should confirm whether session is allowed in hosted private vs public endpoint.

qa-bot: automation test run queued for shim branch #512 — ETA 20m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

sam: escalating to platform team for SDK patch and runtime soft-accept for `session` key in legacy mode. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary deploy?

deploy-bot: canary queued on dedicated-us-east-1, tag: shim-orderid-coerce, timeout 30m

eli: customer thanks, wants ETA for fix.

alex: telling customer 2-3 hours for canary + verification. will follow up with patch notes and recommended SDK upgrade.

maria: follow-up action items: 1) add clearer 400 message listing missing fields 2) add type-coercion shim for order_id for v0.9.x 3) document additionalProperties behaviour in API breaking changes doc.

alex: noted. closing after canary passes. :thumbsup:
